# tuna_temporal_token (Resource)

A temporary tunnel token with restrictions, suitable for CI and short-lived environments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tuna_temporal_token" "ci" {
  description              = "CI run token"
  duration                 = "24h"
  allow_http               = true
  allow_tcp                = false
  limit_by_active_tunnels  = 5
  limit_by_created_tunnels = 100
}

output "ci_tunnel_token" {
  value     = tuna_temporal_token.ci.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the token.

### Optional

- `allow_http` (Boolean) Allow creating HTTP tunnels.
- `allow_tcp` (Boolean) Allow creating TCP tunnels.
- `duration` (String) Lifetime of the token (for example, 24h). The API stores only the resulting expired_at.
- `limit_by_active_tunnels` (Number) Limit on the number of active tunnels.
- `limit_by_created_tunnels` (Number) Limit on the total number of created tunnels.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `expired_at` (String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The tunnel token value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tuna_temporal_token.ci 123
```
